R-SUBSYSTEM-OWNERS.observable: owner map in reconstruction, cited to kit
R-SUBSYSTEM-OWNERS.notes: standing-record-verified -- every owner row cites a document present in the kit

R-E0-VS-E1-E3.requirement: Distinguish E0 (prior detector execution) from E1..E3 (re-evaluation of current retained evidence).
R-E0-VS-E1-E3.notes: reconstructed-behavior -- pivot vocabulary re-read from the comparison schema and joined to the admitted comparison

R-PIVOT-ONLY-FINGERPRINTS.requirement: Fingerprints present only in pivots are retained as such.
R-PIVOT-ONLY-FINGERPRINTS.notes: schema-admitted-record -- re-admitted; a pivot-only entry retained

R-HOST-CAPTURED-VS-CANDIDATE.requirement: Host-captured required work vs candidate-only returns from retained observations.
R-HOST-CAPTURED-VS-CANDIDATE.notes: reconstructed-behavior -- consumable imports recomputed from retained correspondence

R-EMPTY-PARTIAL-UNAVAILABLE-MISSING.requirement: Complete-empty, partial, unavailable, and missing committed bytes are distinct states.
R-EMPTY-PARTIAL-UNAVAILABLE-MISSING.observable: exhibited across syntax/availability/Coverage artifacts; a single label for all four is failure
R-EMPTY-PARTIAL-UNAVAILABLE-MISSING.notes: reconstructed-behavior -- every measured row re-joined to a Coverage payload of that Run evidence

R-DETECTOR-COMPAT-FILE.requirement: If reconstructed, detector compatibility listing is the reserved authenticated file, not the component manifest body. The kit's signed-tree/canonical metadata owners apply.
R-DETECTOR-COMPAT-FILE.observable: vector distinguishing listing file vs manifest body, citing kit owners
R-DETECTOR-COMPAT-FILE.notes: reconstructed-behavior -- the detector closure descriptor and its retained component manifest re-read from the TS store

R-VALIDATE-OWNING-SCHEMA.requirement: Every record of a claimed complete positive is validated against its owning schema, including published kit keywords stock JSON Schema ignores unless independently implemented.
R-VALIDATE-OWNING-SCHEMA.observable: per-record validation log; schemaErrors that ignore published keywords are not evidence of admission
R-VALIDATE-OWNING-SCHEMA.notes: reconstructed-behavior -- per Run: store re-hashed on load; schema log, closure and provider context re-read

R-INDEPENDENT-CLOSURE-JOINS.requirement: Independently implement and execute retained closure and cross-record joins named by the kit registries (relation laws, digest-domain snapshot/nested/blob joins, coverage totality/partition where present).
R-INDEPENDENT-CLOSURE-JOINS.observable: closure result per claimed complete positive, distinct from schema-only validation
R-INDEPENDENT-CLOSURE-JOINS.notes: reconstructed-behavior -- per Run: store re-hashed on load; schema log, closure and provider context re-read

R-OBJECT-TABLE-FRAMES.requirement: For every claimed complete positive: object table plus all exact blob/frame bytes keyed by digest.
R-OBJECT-TABLE-FRAMES.observable: runs/<id>.store.json (or equivalent) containing objectTable and blobs
R-OBJECT-TABLE-FRAMES.notes: reconstructed-behavior -- per Run: store re-hashed on load; schema log, closure and provider context re-read

R-FROM-SCRATCH-COMMAND.requirement: An executable from-scratch command recomputes identities and validates those complete graphs from the export.
R-FROM-SCRATCH-COMMAND.notes: reconstructed-behavior -- the command names the reference interpreter and this runtime; read order holds

R-RETAINED-ARTIFACTS-IN-CLOSURE.requirement: Required referenced artifacts are in the export and rehashed.
R-RETAINED-ARTIFACTS-IN-CLOSURE.notes: reconstructed-behavior -- per Run: store re-hashed on load; schema log, closure and provider context re-read

R-SELECTED-PROVIDER-CONTEXT.requirement: Each language/grammar Run uses its actual selected provider and capability context.
R-SELECTED-PROVIDER-CONTEXT.observable: provider/context fields on each complete Run
R-SELECTED-PROVIDER-CONTEXT.notes: reconstructed-behavior -- per Run: store re-hashed on load; schema log, closure and provider context re-read

R-VALID-VS-INVALID-VS-EXPLANATORY.requirement: Valid controls, invalid mutations, and explanatory calculations are labeled distinct.
R-VALID-VS-INVALID-VS-EXPLANATORY.notes: measured-control -- every admission/refusal row carries (or inherits) a classification

R-MEASURED-NOT-COUNTS.requirement: Measured results. PASS line counts are not conformance.
R-MEASURED-NOT-COUNTS.observable: assertions or failing process status on required controls
R-MEASURED-NOT-COUNTS.notes: measured-control -- every recorded stage exit is zero and the read-order guard holds

R-NEGATIVE-FIRST-REFUSAL.requirement: Every negative records first refusal and masking.
R-NEGATIVE-FIRST-REFUSAL.observable: firstRefusal and masksLater on each negative
R-NEGATIVE-FIRST-REFUSAL.notes: measured-control -- every refused row (not already covered by an enclosing row) carries a first refusal and a masking record

R-DISTINGUISH-FOUR-BOUNDARIES.requirement: Those four boundaries stay distinct. Helper predicates are not closure. Closure is not host enforcement.
R-DISTINGUISH-FOUR-BOUNDARIES.observable: per claimed positive: schema vs helper vs closure vs (not claimed) host
R-DISTINGUISH-FOUR-BOUNDARIES.notes: standing-record-verified -- schema log, closure report, replay report and a host-not-claimed standing per Run

R-HELPER-KIT-ONLY.requirement: Helper bugs: correct from kit only; preserve original failure and correction. Helper bug ≠ design gap. Missing/contradictory required recipe = design gap. Open helper failure on a claimed positive forbids ACCEPT.
R-HELPER-KIT-ONLY.observable: helperCorrections[] with original failure, kit selector, correction
R-HELPER-KIT-ONLY.notes: standing-record-verified -- every correction row carries original failure, kit selector and correction; none open

R-REPLAY-AFTER-ADMISSION.requirement: Replay after admission, not instead of it. A linkage-valid graph that has not passed this replay is not a complete positive.
R-REPLAY-AFTER-ADMISSION.observable: replay export per claimed complete positive, gated on closure
R-REPLAY-AFTER-ADMISSION.notes: reconstructed-behavior -- replay gated on closure; a retention control never reaches replay

R-REPLAY-ENUM-AND-IDS.requirement: Independently derive complete subject enumeration and exact matchingFactIds and coverageIds.
R-REPLAY-ENUM-AND-IDS.observable: replay record containing those derived ids
R-REPLAY-ENUM-AND-IDS.notes: reconstructed-behavior -- replayed ids joined to the retained proof

R-REPLAY-PREDICATE-WITNESS-VERDICT.requirement: Predicate addresses, child values, witnesses, all finding emissions, final verdict from those inputs.
R-REPLAY-PREDICATE-WITNESS-VERDICT.notes: reconstructed-behavior -- witness bytes, findings and verdict replayed; atom witnesses re-derived independently

R-REPLAY-NO-CALLER-TRUTH.requirement: No caller-authored truth / empty-match flags / literal pass-fail substitutes.
R-REPLAY-NO-CALLER-TRUTH.notes: measured-control -- the replay input builder reads no claimed output value; the atom instrument imports no evaluator

R-REPLAY-COMPARE-BUNDLE.requirement: Compare the independently recomputed complete proof bundle to the retained claim; refuse mismatch.
R-REPLAY-COMPARE-BUNDLE.observable: byte/identity comparison result per positive; mismatch ⇒ that positive fails
R-REPLAY-COMPARE-BUNDLE.notes: reconstructed-behavior -- complete bundle comparison equal; tampered bundles refused by the same comparison

R-REPLAY-EXPORT.requirement: Export replayed inputs, computed proof, and comparison for every positive Run.
R-REPLAY-EXPORT.observable: runs/<id>.replay.json (or equivalent) for each claimed positive
R-REPLAY-EXPORT.notes: reconstructed-behavior -- one replay export per current Run

R-REPLAY-THREE-VALUED.requirement: Missing relation Coverage with no match follows the published three-valued law.
R-REPLAY-THREE-VALUED.observable: vector showing indeterminate, not vacuous true/false
R-REPLAY-THREE-VALUED.notes: reconstructed-behavior -- missing Coverage with no match is indeterminate, re-derived independently

R-REPLAY-TAMPER.requirement: Tamper control: preserve valid record identities and citation membership, change claimed logical result, replay refuses. Keep this separate from future authentication/host qualification.
R-REPLAY-TAMPER.observable: tamper vector with refused=true and identities/citations described
R-REPLAY-TAMPER.notes: measured-control -- identities reminted, citations preserved, closure admits, replay refuses

R-ROOT-ADMISSION-EXPORT.requirement: Export is sufficient for independent root admission of the exact bytes afterward. The consumer must not ACCEPT on helper self-consistency. The consumer must not import author models to obtain that admission.
R-ROOT-ADMISSION-EXPORT.observable: Exact exported object table and all referenced retained blobs/frames for every claimed complete positive, exposed for external root admission. Consumer reports only its own independently executed admission/replay; root outcome remains unobserved until root checks the final bytes.
R-ROOT-ADMISSION-EXPORT.notes: standing-record-verified -- exact object table and blobs exported for every positive; root outcome not claimed

R-IDENTIFY-GAPS.requirement: Identify missing recipe / conflicting vocabulary / circular authority / ambiguous default / forced invention. Exact selectors.
R-IDENTIFY-GAPS.observable: newMustIssues/newShouldIssues or an explicit empty-with-justification after all acceptBlocking items executed
R-IDENTIFY-GAPS.notes: standing-record-verified -- must/should arrays exist; every issue cites a selector; empty is justified

R-FREEDOM-VS-MISSING.notes: standing-record-verified -- algorithm-freedom items recorded separately from gaps

R-BLOCKER-NOT-ADJUST.requirement: Exact blocker, not adjusted meaning, not imported author code.
R-BLOCKER-NOT-ADJUST.observable: BLOCKED or CHANGES_REQUIRED with selector, or all promised vectors built
R-BLOCKER-NOT-ADJUST.notes: standing-record-verified -- an exact blocker statement is recorded

R-DELIVER-MD-JSON.requirement: Deliver both review files plus retained source and machine-readable vector outputs.
R-DELIVER-MD-JSON.notes: standing-record-verified over the review files of THIS command

R-VERDICT-ENUM.requirement: Verdict is one of ACCEPT-RECONSTRUCTABLE, CHANGES_REQUIRED, BLOCKED. Substantive, not a checklist count. Any remaining MUST/SHOULD design gap requires CHANGES_REQUIRED.
R-VERDICT-ENUM.notes: standing-record-verified over the review files of THIS command

R-MUST-SHOULD-ADVISORY.requirement: newMustIssues and newShouldIssues empty only when no unresolved required finding remains. Advisories separate. Exact selectors.
R-MUST-SHOULD-ADVISORY.notes: standing-record-verified over the review files of THIS command

R-NO-ACCEPT-IF-INCOMPLETE.requirement: ACCEPT is forbidden while any acceptBlocking requirement is unexecuted or any claimed complete positive fails schema/closure/replay/export. Incomplete or helper failure cannot ACCEPT.
R-NO-ACCEPT-IF-INCOMPLETE.observable: verdict plus unexecuted list; if unexecuted nonempty then verdict ≠ ACCEPT-RECONSTRUCTABLE
R-NO-ACCEPT-IF-INCOMPLETE.notes: standing-record-verified over the review files of THIS command

R-NO-QUALIFICATION-CLAIM.requirement: No product qualification or implementation authorization claim.
R-NO-QUALIFICATION-CLAIM.observable: standing text in both review files
R-NO-QUALIFICATION-CLAIM.notes: standing-record-verified over the review files of THIS command

R-GRAPH-QUERY-OPERATION-DISCLOSURE-CURSO.requirement: Independently execute the complete required query reconstruction specified in the charter against already admitted retained Run(s), using the frozen incorporated query owner. No new Run or product engine is required solely for this item.
R-GRAPH-QUERY-OPERATION-DISCLOSURE-CURSO.observable: Executable query vectors with input selections, independently derived complete typed responses, failure envelopes, bound/cursor cases, renderer and summary joins, and measured results
R-GRAPH-QUERY-OPERATION-DISCLOSURE-CURSO.notes: schema-admitted-record -- every retained request/response of BOTH query artifacts re-admitted; both bound to the current TS Run

F-OS-COMPILER-CRYPTO-SQLITE.requirement: Do not demand real OS/compiler/crypto/SQLite measurements. Do not treat their absence as a design gap.
F-OS-COMPILER-CRYPTO-SQLITE.notes: not demanded as a current blocker; the compiler, provider and OS observations of this origin are SYNTHETIC TRUSTED INPUTS

F-SYNTHETIC-TCB.requirement: Synthetic TCB observations are assumptions, never native enforcement proof.
F-SYNTHETIC-TCB.notes: not demanded as a current blocker; the compiler, provider and OS observations of this origin are SYNTHETIC TRUSTED INPUTS

F-AUTH-HOST.requirement: Replay tamper control is not authentication/host qualification.
F-AUTH-HOST.observable: tamper vector classified as evaluator replay, not host auth
F-AUTH-HOST.notes: not demanded as a current blocker; the compiler, provider and OS observations of this origin are SYNTHETIC TRUSTED INPUTS
